stem:
A student investigates the resonant frequency of a metal rod. The metal rod of length *L* is suspended from two rubber loops. A sensitive microphone with a cone is positioned at one end of the rod. The microphone is attached to an oscilloscope, as shown in Fig. 2.1.

[[fig:f1]]

The rod is hit gently with a hammer.

The period *T* of the trace produced on the oscilloscope is determined.

The experiment is repeated for different values of *L*.

It is suggested that *T* and *L* are related by the equation

$T = \frac{2L^n}{C}$

where *C* and *n* are constants.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
A graph is plotted of lg *T* on the *y*-axis against lg *L* on the *x*-axis.

Determine expressions for the gradient and *y*-intercept.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Values of *L* and *T* are given in Table 2.1.

[[fig:f2]]

Calculate and record values of lg (*L* / cm) and lg (*T* / 10⁻⁵ s) in Table 2.1. Include the absolute uncertainties in lg *T*.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Plot a graph of lg (*T* / 10⁻⁵ s) against lg (*L* / cm). Include error bars for lg *T*.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Draw the straight line of best fit and a worst acceptable straight line on your graph. Label both lines.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text:
Determine the gradient of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

[[fig:f3]]

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text: Determine the *y*-intercept of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Using your answers to (a), (c)(iii) and (c)(iv), determine the values of *n* and *C*. Include the absolute uncertainties in your values. You need not be concerned with units.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text: The experiment is repeated. Determine the length *L* of the rod that gives a value of *T* of 0.10 ms.

figures.caption: Fig. 2.1 (not to scale)
figures.alt: A metal rod is suspended by two rubber loops on a stand above a bench, with a hammer at one end and a microphone and cone at the other.

figures.caption: Table 2.1

A blank graph grid with lg (L / cm) on the horizontal axis and lg (T / 10⁻⁵ s) on the vertical axis.
